name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: Confetti for the moments that deserve it — a coupon applied, a reward revealed, an order placed. Pieces fly on real arcs (launch, gravity, air drag) and flutter as they fall; one native-driven animation moves them all. Cannons, rain or a pop under your finger; respects Reduce Motion.
summary: Confetti that flies on real arcs with gravity and drag, then flutters as it falls.
behavior: Each burst launches pieces with velocity, gravity and air drag, all moved by one native-driven animation. Bursts can overlap.
The overlay fills its parent and never takes touches.
Bursts launch a quarter of the pieces.
The overlay is hidden from assistive tech.
props: Rain from the top, pop outward, or two cannons from the bottom corners.
